purpose: Record which readings of Delta are permitted and which are prohibited before numerical metric formalization is attempted.

non_claims: Does not define a finalized metric.

allowed_readings: Delta may compare asymmetry under a fixed declared <S>.
Delta may expose admissibility under the reference coupling.
Delta may carry qualitative or ordinal structure.
forbidden_readings: Delta is not automatically Euclidean distance.
Delta is not automatically scalar magnitude.
Delta does not imply role symmetry.
Delta does not imply universal measurability.
Delta does not erase residue-asymmetry r_a.

policy_reading.statement: The allowed readings support a provisional bridge; the forbidden readings prevent ordinary distance, norm, or unit-space collapse.
